description: Continuation of the exploratory sub-decision-period command-transport latency ladder after the independent 100/120 ms quick tier passed. This protocol tests only 140 and 160 ms FIFO delay from the frozen K10 Navigator to frozen locomotion velocity-command input; it is not a 200 ms-quantized high-level decision-delay test.

quick_gate.note: The stress ladder advances only when every frozen quick EpisodeSpec succeeds with no fall or invalid state. A timeout, fall, or invalid state defines the first failed delay tier.

full_gate.note: Formal is user-launched only after every quick condition passes. This exploratory tier does not replace the v1 operational-delay formal protocol.
